$comment: HZ-448: the contract for a Plan's item drafts — the `plan_draft` object the Draft items step replies with, and the whole document an owner saves through PUT /api/items/:id/plan-draft. Like runPlan.schema.json it pairs with no data file: it is the contract for an agent's OUTPUT. Both bindings interpret this file directly — domain/py/plan_draft.py on the farm, domain/js/planDraft.js on the server — so a shape rule lives here once. The work-item field limits are NOT restated here: each binding adds them at load from domain/fields.json — title and outcome lengths, repo's maximum, and metric's and guardrails' line caps as maxItems (PLAN_DRAFT_SCHEMA / SCHEMA). Rules a schema cannot express — no blank text, unique plan-local ids, every `#n` dependency names a draft in the set, no cycle — are the bindings'. Only the server knows which real keys and repos exist (unknown_key, unknown_repo).
title: Horizon Plan item drafts

items.$comment: The items the Plan would file, in display order. New items are named only by plan-local id (#1, #2, …); a real key is assigned at filing, in Approve & file (HZ-449).

depends_on.$comment: A plan-local id (#n) of another draft here, or the real key of an EXISTING item — open or closed.

shared_guardrails.$comment: Guardrails every drafted item carries, on top of its own.
